scope.description: Bounded verification API result after same-history replacement election; initial static leader/configuration fixture and controlled worker scheduling.
assumptions: Initial L term-7 leader with matching static three-voter configuration is a permitted prefix.
Crash-only delays/partition; no forged vote or heartbeat response.
No L reacquisition or configuration changes during the operation.

properties.reason: Actual result fields are compared after independent prerequisite association
limitations: Required observed fields, event identity, or prerequisite association are missing

adaptations: Manual initial leader/configuration and worker wiring; no NewRaft startup or runLeader noop.
Injected transport executes receiver handlers and partitions election RPCs to L.
Only F heartbeat worker is run; N replication and normal append workers are not scheduled.
Heartbeat and leader lease timers on L are one hour; replacement F uses a validated 5ms heartbeat timeout and 200ms election timeout.
boundaries: Initial L leader state and committed configuration are fixtures; startup/election prefix not executed.
Ordinary replication and full runLeader setup are omitted; the controlled window represents their delay, without claiming all production schedules admit it.
Application reads and committed-log safety are excluded.
